G1100.def: of uncertain affinity; the tongue; by implication, a language (specially, one naturally unacquired):--tongue.

G1101.def: from «1100» and the base of «2889»; properly, a case (to keep mouthpieces of wind-instruments in) i.e. (by extension) a casket or (specially) purse:--bag.

G1102.et: by variation for a derivative from knapto (to tease cloth)
G1102.def: by variation for a derivative from knapto (to tease cloth); a cloth-dresser:--fuller.

G1103.def: from the same as «1077»; legitimate (of birth), i.e. genuine:--own, sincerity, true.

G1105.def: akin to «3509»; gloom (as of a storm):--blackness.

G1106.pos:
1. the faculty of knowledge, mind, reason
  2. that which is thought or known, one's mind
    1. view, judgment, opinion
    2. mind concerning what ought to be done
      1. by one's self: resolve purpose, intention
      2. by others: judgment, advice
      3. decree
G1106.def: from «1097»; cognition, i.e. (subjectively) opinion, or (objectively) resolve (counsel, consent, etc.):--advice, + agree, judgment, mind, purpose, will.

G1107.def: from a derivative of «1097»; to make known; subjectively, to know:--certify, declare, make known, give to understand, do to wit, wot.

G1108.def: from «1097»; knowing (the act), i.e. (by implication) knowledge:--knowledge, science.

G1110.def: from «1097»; well-known:--acquaintance, (which may be) known, notable.

G1114.def: from goao (to wail); properly, a wizard (as muttering spells), i.e. (by implication) an imposter:--seducer.

G1115.def: of Chaldee origin (compare «01538»); the skull; Golgotha, a knoll near Jerusalem:--Golgotha.

G1116.def: of Hebrew origin («06017»); Gomorrha (i.e. Amorah), a place near the Dead Sea:--Gomorrha.

G1117.def: from «1073»; a load (as filling), i.e. (specially) a cargo, or (by extension) wares:--burden, merchandise.

G1118.def: from the base of «1096»; a parent:--parent.

G1120.et: from a compound of (1119) and the alternate of (4098)
G1120.def: from a compound of «1119» and the alternate of «4098»; to fall on the knee:--bow the knee, kneel down.

G1121.def: from «1125»; a writing, i.e. a letter, note, epistle, book, etc.; plural learning:--bill, learning, letter, scripture, writing, written.

G1122.def: from «1121». a writer, i.e. (professionally) scribe or secretary:--scribe, town-clerk.

G1124.def: a document, i.e. holy Writ (or its contents or a statement in it):--scripture.

G1125.def: a primary verb; to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe:--describe, write(-ing, -ten).

G1126.def: from graus (an old woman) and «1491»; crone-like, i.e. silly:--old wives'.

G1127.def: from «1453»; to keep awake, i.e. watch (literally or figuratively):--be vigilant, wake, (be) watch(-ful).

G1128.def: from «1131»; to practise naked (in the games), i.e. train (figuratively):--exercise.

G1130.def: from a derivative of «1131»; to strip, i.e. (reflexively) go poorly clad:--be naked.

G1131.def: of uncertain affinity; nude (absolute or relative, literal or figurative):--naked.

G1133.def: a diminutive from «1135»; a little (i.e. foolish) woman:--silly woman.

G1135.def: probably from the base of «1096»; a woman; specially, a wife:--wife, woman.

G1136.def: of Hebrew origin («01463»); Gog, a symbolic name for some future Antichrist:--Gog.

G1137.def: probably akin to «1119»; an angle:--corner, quarter.

G1138.def: of Hebrew origin («01732»); Dabid (i.e. David), the Israelite king:--David.

G1139.def: middle voice from «1142»; to be exercised by a dæmon:--have a (be vexed with, be possessed with) devil(-s).

G1140.def: neuter of a derivative of «1142»; a dæmonic being; by extension a deity:--devil, god.

G1142.def: from daio (to distribute fortunes); a dæmon or supernatural spirit (of a bad nature):--devil.

G1143.et: a prolonged form of a primary root
G1143.def: a prolonged form of a primary root; to bite, i.e. (figuratively) thwart:--bite.

G1148.def: probably of Chaldee origin; Dalmanutha, a place in Palestine:--Dalmanutha.

G1149.def: probably of foreign derivation; Dalmatia, a region of Europe:--Dalmatia.

G1150.et: a variation of an obsolete primary of the same meaning
G1150.def: a variation of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to tame:--tame.

G1151.def: probably from the base of «1150»; a heifer (as tame):--heifer.

G1152.def: probably from the base of «1150»; perhaps gentle; Damaris, an Athenian woman:--Damaris.

G1153.def: from «1154»; a Damascene or inhabitant of Damascus:--Damascene.

G1154.def: of Hebrew origin («01834»); Damascus, a city of Syria:--Damascus.

G1155.def: from «1156»; to loan on interest; reflexively, to borrow:--borrow, lend.

G1156.def: from danos (a gift); probably akin to the base of «1325»; a loan:--debt.

G1158.def: of Hebrew origin («01840»); Daniel, an Israelite:--Daniel.

G1159.def: from «1160»; to expend, i.e. (in a good sense) to incur cost, or (in a bad one) to waste:--be at charges, consume, spend.

G1161.def: a primary particle (adversative or continuative); but, and, etc.:--also, and, but, moreover, now (often unexpressed in English).

G1163.et: third person singular active present of (1210)
G1163.def: 3d person singular active present of «1210»; also deon deh-on'; neuter active participle of the same; both used impersonally; it is (was, etc.) necessary (as binding):--behoved, be meet, must (needs), (be) need(-ful), ought, should.

G1164.def: from the base of «1166»; a specimen (as shown):--example.

G1166.et: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary of the same meaning
G1166.def: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to show (literally or figuratively):--shew.

G1169.def: from deos (dread); timid, i.e. (by implication) faithless:--fearful.

G1170.et: probably from the same as (1171) (through the idea of forgetting the name as fearful, i.e. strange)
G1170.def: probably from the same as «1171» (through the idea of forgetting the name as fearful, i.e. strange); so and so (when the person is not specified):--such a man.

G1171.et: from a derivative of the same as (1169)
G1171.def: adverb from a derivative of the same as «1169»; terribly, i.e. excessively:--grievously, vehemently.

G1172.def: from «1173»; to dine, i.e. take the principle (or evening) meal:--sup (X -er).

G1173.def: from the same as «1160»; dinner, i.e. the chief meal (usually in the evening):--feast, supper.

G1174.et: the compound of a derivative of the base of (1169) and (1142)
G1174.def: the compound of a derivative of the base of «1169» and «1142»; more religious than others:--too superstitious.

G1177.def: from «1176» and «1417»; two and ten, i.e. twelve:--twelve.

G1178.def: from «1176» and «4002»; ten and five, i.e. fifteen:--fifteen.

G1179.def: from «1176» and «4172»; the ten-city region; the Decapolis, a district in Syria:--Decapolis.

G1180.def: from «1176» and «5064»; ten and four, i.e. fourteen:--fourteen.

G1181.def: feminine of «1182»; a tenth, i.e. as a percentage or (technically) tithe:--tenth (part), tithe.

G1183.def: from «1181»; to tithe, i.e. to give or take a tenth:--pay (receive) tithes.

G1185.def: from the base of «1388»; to entrap, i.e. (figuratively) delude:--allure, beguile, entice.

G1186.def: probably from drus (an oak); a tree:--tree.

G1187.def: from «1188» and «2983»; a guardsman (as if taking the right) or light-armed soldier:--spearman.

G1188.def: from «1209»; the right side or (feminine) hand (as that which usually takes):--right (hand, side).

G1189.def: middle voice of «1210»; to beg (as binding oneself), i.e. petition:--beseech, pray (to), make request. Compare «4441».

G1190.def: from «1191»; a Derbæan or inhabitant of Derbe:--of Derbe.

G1191.def: of foreign origin; Derbe, a place in Asia Minor:--Derbe.

G1193.def: from «1192»; made of hide:--leathern, of a skin.

G1194.def: a primary verb; properly, to flay, i.e. (by implication) to scourge, or (by analogy) to thrash:--beat, smite.

G1195.def: from a (presumed) derivative of «1196»; to be a binder (captor), i.e. to enchain (a prisoner), to tie on (a load):-- bind.

G1198.def: from «1199»; a captive (as bound):--in bonds, prisoner.

G1199.def: neuter and masculine respectively from «1210»; a band, i.e. ligament (of the body) or shackle (of a prisoner); figuratively, an impediment or disability:--band, bond, chain, string.
